title: Warm-Startable Progressive Integrality Outer-Inner Approximation for AC Unit Commitment with Conic Formulation
summary: The alternating-current unit commitment problem provides a realistic representation of power system operations, which is a nonconvex mixed-integer nonlinear programming problem and hence is computationally intractable. A common relaxation to the alternating-current unit commitment problem is based on the second-order cone, which results in a mixed-integer second-order cone program and remains computationally challenging. In this paper, we propose a warm-startable outer-inner approximation framework that alternatively solves a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) as an outer approximation…
